name: kanorio
description: Website styles for AI tools, and the Kanorio skill.

plugins.name: apple-style
plugins.description: Full-bleed tiles alternate light grey, white and black, each giving one product its name, a short tagline, two blue pill buttons and a big studio picture.

plugins.name: airbnb-style
plugins.description: A white page where rounded photographs do the talking, one warm coral saved for the next step, and a pill-shaped search bar that reads where, when, who.

plugins.name: spotify-style
plugins.description: Near-black rounded panels inside a black frame, square cover art in sideways rails, one green for play and pill-shaped controls everywhere.

plugins.name: notion-style
plugins.description: A warm white page, ink-black type and a few soft pastel blocks, calm and friendly like a well-kept notebook.

plugins.name: nike-style
plugins.description: Full-bleed black and white photographs with huge condensed capitals on them, framed by quiet white pages, black pill buttons and products on soft gray tiles.

plugins.name: stripe-style
plugins.description: A white canvas swept by one soft multicolour gradient, thin two-tone headlines and crisp interface cards floating on blue-tinted shadows.

plugins.name: m-plus-style
plugins.description: Three full-height stripes of saturated color, white type set straight on them, a giant hairline outline of the wordmark and outlined oval buttons.

plugins.name: duolingo-style
plugins.description: A white page, chunky lowercase headlines in leaf green, buttons that sink when pressed and big-eyed cartoon characters that take turns on either side.

plugins.name: metallica-style
plugins.description: Black stage bands and grainy paper bands meeting at hard diagonals, heavy geometric capitals and giant outlined words, loud like a screen-printed tour poster.

plugins.name: linear-style
plugins.description: A near-black canvas lit by one soft violet glow, with gradient headlines, hairline edges and the product's own interface as the centerpiece.

plugins.name: oatly-style
plugins.description: Grid paper inside a thin-lined window, bordered tiles with colored category stickers, and hand-cut condensed capitals annotated with marker doodles.

plugins.name: youtube-style
plugins.description: A white app frame with a left icon sidebar and a pill search on top, and shelves of rounded thumbnails with running times, titles and view counts filling the rest.

plugins.name: wired-style
plugins.description: Paper white and black ink, tall condensed headlines, small monospaced capitals and black tabs on heavy rules, so a crowded page still reads in perfect order.

plugins.name: dishoom-style
plugins.description: Cream paper, pictures hung in double-rule frames with small captions, and headings spaced out wide and slow, like a sign painter lettering a café window.

plugins.name: nintendo-style
plugins.description: A bright white page with one signal red: a red tab for the wordmark, titles on a short red rule, rounded cards under red tabs and a red dot on everything you can open.

plugins.name: coachella-style
plugins.description: Cream paper, forest-green serif headlines and a poster of names under a dusk sky, with cut-paper plants and objects resting at the edges of the page.

plugins.name: hobonichi-style
plugins.description: A warm white page under a dated masthead, a pastel band that changes color with each story, and short hand-broken lines that read like a note from a friend.

plugins.name: tesla-style
plugins.description: One product per screen, edge to edge, with a calm name above it, two flat buttons below and an interface so quiet it almost disappears.

plugins.name: instagram-style
plugins.description: A white page held together by hairlines, with faces in warm gradient rings, tall story cards fanned out with stickers, and photographs packed into a tight grid.

plugins.name: google-style
plugins.description: An almost empty white page holds a centered wordmark, one rounded search box and two quiet grey buttons, with small links tucked into the corners.

plugins.name: roblox-style
plugins.description: A dark wall of tilted square art behind one compact card, then bright shelves of square tiles, a wide chunky display face and one electric blue that means go.

plugins.name: whatsapp-style
plugins.description: A warm cream page where the conversation is the design: chat bubbles float over everyday photographs and big, calm headlines speak in plain sentences.

plugins.name: lady-gaga-style
plugins.description: A black page lit like a stage, where each chapter is its own era, announced by one roughened serif word over grainy art, and the year unfolds as dated moments.

plugins.name: netflix-style
plugins.description: A warm near-black stage, a tilted wall of poster art behind one huge headline, a glowing red arc and rows of titles lettered in tall condensed capitals.

plugins.name: telegram-style
plugins.description: Plain white pages, a round mark at the centre, blue words you can click and a grid of cheerful die-cut stickers, friendly and easy to trust.

plugins.name: bbc-style
plugins.description: A white page under a centred block wordmark, sturdy serif headlines over small time stamps in calm columns, and red kept for whatever is happening right now.

plugins.name: nvidia-style
plugins.description: White pages and pale grey bands, bold headlines, one acid green on square buttons, rows of rounded cards sliding off the edge and products lit on black.

plugins.name: amazon-style
plugins.description: A cool gray shelf of square white boxes under a deep blue-black bar with one wide search field, where colour bands and red discount tags do the selling.

plugins.name: snapchat-style
plugins.description: A white page split in two: a calm sign-up column that stays put beside tall photo cards that scroll, each with one big white sentence and a dark pill.

plugins.name: kendrick-lamar-style
plugins.description: An empty white page with a few pixel folders left on it like things on a desk, small monospace words at the edges, and a black page behind every folder you open.

plugins.name: microsoft-style
plugins.description: A white header over a softly tinted hero, one centered greeting, a pill switch and a large ask box with chips, then big rounded product cards on pastel grounds.

plugins.name: claude-style
plugins.description: Warm paper and warm ink, editorial serif headlines, one terracotta accent, and the product shown in dark cards resting on soft, contour-lined clay tiles.

plugins.name: discord-style
plugins.description: A deep blurple night sky full of sparkles, huge glass frames with soft corners around bright panels, and little 3D toys drifting past wide, heavy titles.

plugins.name: nick-style
plugins.description: A full-bleed cartoon with a chunky white title, then hot orange bands of goo blobs carrying tight rows of white cards on a hard orange-red underline.

plugins.name: pinterest-style
plugins.description: A white page given over to a wall of pictures at their own shapes, every corner rounded, with one red button to keep what you love.

plugins.name: ibm-style
plugins.description: White pages ruled by hairlines, one corporate blue, square corners, large light headlines and flat grey tiles with an arrow pinned in the corner.

plugins.name: ferrari-style
plugins.description: A pure black page, wide extended capitals in white, one deep red for the main action, and low-light photographs as the only decoration.

plugins.name: starbucks-style
plugins.description: A white header with uppercase navigation, deep green bands and half-photo, half-colour blocks, with friendly copy centred beside each picture.

plugins.name: sesame-street-style
plugins.description: Saturated pill buttons, one colour per section, over full-bleed bright canvases with paper confetti, white-framed cards with round corner badges and chubby type.

plugins.name: steam-style
plugins.description: A deep blue page lit from the top, where cover art fills every slot and a lime discount sits beside a struck-through price in a small dark box.

plugins.name: revolut-style
plugins.description: Whole-screen photographs carry huge white headlines and a glass phone frame, then the page cuts to black, white and grey bands that each hold one idea.

plugins.name: burning-man-style
plugins.description: Night photographs of lit art, peach bands torn across black pages and chunky slab headlines, under a black header with a big search and a donate button.

plugins.name: uber-style
plugins.description: Black and white bands take turns under a black bar of pill links, opening on a booking form of stacked grey fields joined by a thin route line.

plugins.name: starlux-airlines-style
plugins.description: Deep night-teal pages, thin type set large, and night photographs that dissolve slowly into one another, with warm champagne kept for the one thing to press.

plugins.name: league-of-legends-style
plugins.description: Painted night scenes that alternate with pale stone, cut-out heroes breaking out of thin gold rings and diamonds, and huge italic capitals under small upright kickers.

plugins.name: espn-style
plugins.description: A cool grey page under a strip of scores and a dark bar with a slanted red name block, white cards in columns, and every number set in a condensed face.

plugins.name: sap-style
plugins.description: A violet-to-blue gradient band with a white product card floating over it, glossy four-point stars and rounded frames carrying small interface snippets.

plugins.name: signal-style
plugins.description: A white header with one blue button, a soft periwinkle band with a heavy headline and tilted phones, then pastel panels of outlined drawings dotted with halftone.

plugins.name: mistral-ai-style
plugins.description: An off-white page ruled by hairline rails, tight grotesque headlines and pixel-art objects standing on stepped blocks of sun yellow, orange and ember red.

plugins.name: chanel-style
plugins.description: Full-screen photographs stacked one after another, each captioned with a small category line, a large uppercase name and one white button, in pure black and white.

plugins.name: dior-style
plugins.description: Full-bleed films that drift slowly behind a small round play control, a centred serif wordmark, and products standing alone on pale grey tiles.

plugins.name: figma-style
plugins.description: A black-and-white frame in one plain typeface, broken by blocks of colour that each hold a picture, with headlines that state a point in black and explain it in grey.

plugins.name: miffy-style
plugins.description: A deep blue wall of rounded squares in flat primary colours, each holding one simple drawing in a heavy black line, with lowercase rounded type and almost no words.

plugins.name: wise-style
plugins.description: A full-bleed lime field, all-caps headlines heavy enough to read across a room, big rounded color cards holding real numbers, and forest-green pills.

plugins.name: hp-style
plugins.description: A white page broken by light gray bands, where rounded near-black banners each light up one product and catalog rows line up the offer, the specs and a blue button.

plugins.name: kahoot-style
plugins.description: A game-show palette on light grey, with a purple console of coloured mode buttons, gradient cards with folder tabs and one headline word lit in a sunset gradient.

plugins.name: mastercard-style
plugins.description: Warm cream pages, giant plain headlines and candid photos cropped into circles, each with a thin orange orbit line and a round arrow button on its edge.

plugins.name: tony-s-chocolonely-style
plugins.description: Full-width bands of red, green, blue and yellow, each opened by uneven slab capitals stretched to fill the width, with paper cards and framed photos laid on top.

plugins.name: roku-style
plugins.description: A deep purple night, a drawn neon city under a hand-lettered welcome, and the program on glowing screens where one tile at a time wears a white focus ring.

plugins.name: vercel-style
plugins.description: White pages that go pure black in dark mode, big tight headlines, black buttons, monospace labels and hairline grids, with the product's interface as the only picture.

plugins.name: supreme-style
plugins.description: A plain white page, small lowercase typewriter text in one narrow centred column, a live clock under the name, and colour that comes only from the pictures.

plugins.name: din-tai-fung-style
plugins.description: Rice-paper white washed with ink mountains and a single watercolour lotus, with titles split by fine vertical rules over one line of small tracked serif.

plugins.name: tradingview-style
plugins.description: An ink-black opening with one huge geometric headline, then white pages where every number has a unit, a direction and a sparkline beside it.

plugins.name: oura-style
plugins.description: Warm oat paper, one condensed serif line centred in a rounded panel, and soft charcoal pills, so every page feels like a well-made object set down on linen.

plugins.name: pentagram-style
plugins.description: A white canvas, one plain sans at regular weight and a wall of work in mixed sizes, where the pictures bring all the colour and the words stay small beneath them.

plugins.name: aman-style
plugins.description: Warm limewash pages, a fine light serif and calm photographs set into wide, uneven whitespace, where the quiet between things does most of the talking.

plugins.name: tiktok-style
plugins.description: One tall video at a time that snaps to the next, round buttons with counts down its right edge, and a dense wall of vertical tiles one tap away.

plugins.name: alibaba-style
plugins.description: A peach wash, big text tabs and one giant search box with an orange gradient rim, above flat trade cards that show the price range, the minimum order and the maker.

plugins.name: binance-style
plugins.description: A near-black page that opens on one huge yellow number and two heavy white capital words, with rounded charcoal panels of live figures beside it.

plugins.name: wechat-style
plugins.description: A flat green band with one wide arch at its foot opens every page, and below the curve white rounded cards rest on a pale grey floor.

plugins.name: qq-style
plugins.description: A full-screen aurora behind vertical fluted glass, one glowing white title with wide letter-spacing and a single frosted pill, calm as a window at night.
